# A King Who Takes Advice

<!-- STEP id="court-scene" -->
## In the King's Court

Imagine a kingdom in ancient India. The king plans a new land tax. Before he gives the order, he asks his assembly and his ministers what they think.

<!-- STEP id="he-listens" -->
## He Listens

They tell him that the tax is too heavy after a poor harvest, so the king changes his order. He still wears the crown, but he did not decide alone.

**So was ancient India already democratic? This lesson looks at the evidence.**
